tech.summary: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu announced the company is freezing annual salary hikes for 2026, citing a fourfold rise in server prices for data centres and rapidly increasing AI usage costs. Vembu said Zoho will "work hard to avoid mass layoffs" but called the software jobs outlook "grim" — the company hasn't grown headcount in 18 months.
tech.title: Zoho halts 2026 salary hikes, looks to 'avoid mass layoffs' amid surging AI costs

tech.summary: Cyberattacks disrupted European supermarket chains, hijacking refrigeration systems at about 700 of France's 10,000 supermarkets and forcing temperatures as high as 50°C, spoiling food. The French finance minister called it an attack on the heart of the country's food security; the Paris cybercrime unit is investigating. Ahold Delhaize also shut down brand websites in Europe and the US over a separate security issue.
tech.title: Cyberattack targeting refrigeration systems hits 700 French supermarkets

tech.summary: Toptal launched ExpertCrowd, a platform matching 30,000+ vetted domain experts (including 1,000 PhD-level AI specialists) to frontier AI labs for RLHF, RL data generation and model evaluation. It also released the ExpertCrowd-SWE benchmark — 87 codebases across 11 languages — claiming it exposes more model deficiencies than any other published SWE benchmark.
tech.title: Toptal launches ExpertCrowd to train AI with vetted domain experts, releases Frontier SWE benchmark

tech.summary: Workato announced a deal with Indigenous ICT provider Gulanga Group and Trellis Data to bring sovereign AI to Australian businesses and government. The joint offering pairs Workato's enterprise platform with Dukes, an Australian-trained LLM (by Trellis Data's Agentaus) fine-tuned on local data for deeper knowledge of Australian law and policy, keeping data onshore.
tech.title: Workato signs deal with Gulanga and Trellis Data for sovereign AI in Australia

tech.summary: The World AI Summit 2026 opens in Bengaluru on Oct 14-15 at the Sheraton Grand Bangalore, bringing together business leaders, policymakers and AI developers. Enterprise adoption, data infrastructure, cybersecurity and measurable business value of AI top the agenda — with the central question being how companies move from AI pilots to real returns.
tech.title: World AI Summit 2026 begins in Bengaluru on October 14

tech.summary: The Combined Exhibition of Advanced Technologies (CEATEC) 2026 opened Tuesday at Makuhari Messe near Tokyo with AI-powered robots and autonomous machinery in the spotlight. The show hosts 821 exhibitors — with a record 246 startups and university research institutions — and expects over 110,000 visitors across four days.
tech.title: AI robots shine at Japan tech expo

pakistan.summary: PM Shehbaz Sharif told PML-N's parliamentary party the federal government was left with "no option" but to impose emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa after dialogue efforts failed and the security situation deteriorated. He said the final draft of a negotiated deal was almost ready but the other side pulled back at the last moment, adding that Pakistan's progress and survival come first.
pakistan.title: Govt was left with 'no option' but emergency, governor rule: PM Shehbaz

pakistan.summary: The government reduced petrol by Rs2.71 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs0.03 under its daily pricing mechanism, effective Oct 14: petrol now retails at Rs392.66 and HSD at Rs396.82 per litre. Taxes and levies stay heavy — Rs114 per litre on petrol and Rs100 on diesel. HSD has come down from its April peak of Rs520.35.
pakistan.title: Govt reduces petrol price by Rs2.71 per litre, diesel by 3 paisas for Oct 14

pakistan.summary: The Pakistan Army successfully test-launched the extended-range version of the Fatah-2 hypersonic ballistic missile, ISPR said. The system carries advanced navigation and avionics, and can engage targets with high precision while defeating enemy missile defences through its unique trajectory and manoeuvrability. It follows last week's successful Fatah-4 extended-range cruise missile test.
pakistan.title: Pakistan successfully test-fires extended-range Fatah-2 hypersonic ballistic missile

pakistan.summary: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb accepted the chairmanship of the Governing Council of the newly formed Borrowers' Platform — a 30+ developing-country initiative for sovereign debt management and development financing — at the first meeting in Bangkok on the sidelines of the World Bank-IMF annual meetings. UN chief Guterres warned poor and developing countries face a "major economic storm"; UNDP data says they spend ~9.5% of revenue on interest payments, the highest since 2001.
pakistan.title: Pakistan takes chair of Borrowers' Platform amid global debt pressures

pakistan.summary: Sri Lanka beat Pakistan by eight wickets in the third T20I at Rawalpindi to deny the hosts a 3-0 whitewash, though Pakistan took the series 2-1. Kusal Mendis' unbeaten 87 off 48 and Dasun Shanaka's 3 for 21 outshone Sahibzada Farhan's 76, as Sri Lanka chased 169 in the 18th over. Both teams now join England for an ODI tri-series starting Sunday in Rawalpindi.
pakistan.title: Pakistan miss T20 whitewash as Sri Lanka bounce back with 8-wicket win

pakistan.summary: Last call for taxpayers: the extended deadline to file income tax returns for Tax Year 2026 expires Oct 15 (tomorrow). FBR granted the extension to Oct 15 after trade bodies and tax bars cited delayed return forms and IRIS portal glitches. Filings hit ~5.2m by Sept 29 (up 45.8% YoY), but late-filer penalties are now much steeper under the Finance Act 2026-27.
pakistan.title: FBR tax return deadline expires tomorrow — Oct 15 is the last day
